decision.explanation: The original documents D1S1-D1S6 and D2S1-D2S3 explicitly identify 'Freedom Suite' as an album by saxophonist David S. Ware. Document D3 contains a note stating that the text was modified to replace 'David S. Ware' with 'John Coltrane' and explicitly calls this a 'fabricated change' that 'does not reflect historical facts.' Document D4 also contains the fabricated text claiming John Coltrane is the artist, alongside metadata listing 'Producer Steven Joerg & John Coltrane' which appears to be part of the same corrupted/fabricated dataset. Since the prompt instructs to treat audit labels and saved answers as fallible but to rely on original context and reject fabricated claims, 'John Coltrane' is excluded as it is explicitly identified within the source text itself as a fabrication. Only 'David S. Ware' remains as the factually supported artist.
